author: Bobby Grayson
title: defp loops land (fixture defp_loop.ex), and with them the state inference comes free: clauses/2 turns receive arms into handle_info clauses with the loop parameter as the state pattern, so state_from_clauses/2 reads term() and 'no @type state and no init/1' disappears for a raw loop. StreamController then reaches its real blocker: chunk(conn, data), i.e. Plug.Conn.chunk/2, which writes bytes onto an HTTP socket. Also in the body: check_backpressure!/0 reads Process.info(self(), :message_queue_len) -- the model HAS a mailbox but EBehavior is not handed it -- and raises on a slow client. Left blocked at chunk/2.
